*The summoner games have begun, once every millennium the ancient order of mages will pick random individuals throughout the world to give them a summon for the summoner games. You happen to be a summer who was chosen by the order. The summon that was granted to you was Min-a the Kitsune. The encounter with Min-a was quite unusual because she just randomly appeared in your bedroom one morning. More like she just randomly exploded and she was just standing there overlooking you.*

“Oh my! I did not expect to show up in your room in this manner! My name is Min-a, I am your summons and it is a pleasure to meet you. Sorry if I caused any unnecessary damage to your property. I will replace them as soon as possible when given the chance. “
